Use case: stylized-concept. Create an ORIGINAL game modeling reference sheet for Earthfall Frontline: SPITTER. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY (the existing Frontline style sheet); do not reproduce its layout or characters. Match chunky clean low-poly faceted construction, glossy purple organic swarm carapace, orange/red inner glow, dark navy backdrop.
Deliver a landscape 2048x1152 sheet with TWO large consistent orthographic views: FRONT on left and true SIDE on right, identical proportions, neutral standing stance aligned at feet. Include a small neutral human soldier silhouette at 1.8 m for scale, separately at bottom right. Main creature 2.5 m tall: tall and thin, exactly FOUR long slender stilt walking legs attached to a compact body, long curved upright neck ending in narrow spitting mouth. Large exposed luminous ACID GREEN sac on its back, clearly visible in both views, connected by green throat duct. Purple chitin ridges, small orange eye slits. Four legs only; front view may splay for clarity. Distinct fragile ranged enemy, not a charger. Restrained gold technical rules and dimension ticks, simple labels "SPITTER", "FRONT", "SIDE", "2.5 m", "1.8 m". Plain dark navy background. Full creature fits with margins, no cropping. Crisp shapes suitable for rebuilding from basic 3D primitives, very sparse fine detail. No weapons, no logos, no borrowed designs, no HUD, no scene.
assets.revision_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this original SPITTER modeling sheet with ONE targeted correction: the gold human soldier at far right is currently much too small for the labeled scale. Enlarge ONLY that soldier silhouette and its 1.8 m gauge, keeping its feet on the existing baseline. The creature is 2.5 m, so the 1.8 m soldier must be exactly 72% as tall as the spitter from feet to crown: on this 1672x941 image creature is about 690 px high and soldier must be about 495 px high, from baseline near y=793 up to y=298. Fit silhouette within the existing rightmost 260-px space. Put 1.8 m gauge next to enlarged silhouette, readable. Preserve both creature views, title, navy background, front and side labels, colors, all anatomy and overall sheet exactly. No other changes.

Use case: stylized-concept. Original Earthfall Frontline BRUTE creature modeling reference sheet, 2048x1152 landscape. Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: chunky faceted low-poly geometry, glossy purple organic swarm, orange-red glow, navy backdrop and gold sparse lettering. No copied characters.
Two consistent neutral orthographic views, FRONT at left and true SIDE at right, full creature within margins. Brute is a heavy 3 m tall low-slung armored charger with exactly FOUR thick load-bearing walking legs PLUS TWO huge separate forward crusher forelimbs (six limbs total). Each crusher is a massive blunt hammer-shaped chitin fist. Two walking legs per side attached under abdomen; crusher arms attach to shoulders in front of walking legs and are held above ground. Clearly show all six limb attachment points in side view by staggering far legs slightly. Broad head set low, two tiny orange eyes, forward wedge forehead, compact neck, layered overlapping DARK PURPLE carapace plates on back and shoulders, brighter violet bevels, small orange-red gaps, robust readable chunky silhouette without thin spines. No green sac.
Layout: top title "BRUTE"; bottom labels "FRONT", "SIDE"; height dimension "3.0 m". Include a gold silhouette of the teal-style soldier on the SAME GROUNDLINE as creature at far right, precisely 60% of creature height to represent 1.8 m against 3 m, label "1.8 m". It is a true same-scale comparison, not an inset. Both creature views use same pixel height. Minimal technical sheet. No HUD, no environment, no weapon, no logos, no existing-franchise designs.
assets.revision_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Keep this BRUTE concept sheet unchanged except correct the GOLD SOLDIER SCALE at far right. Brute top at about y=232 and feet at y=666 means height 434 pixels for 3.0 m. Gold 1.8 m soldier must be 260 pixels tall: keep feet at y=666 and enlarge upward to head at y=406 (currently head too low). Preserve front and side creature art, all six limbs, lighting, colors, navy background, border and lettering. One correction only.

Leader's unmistakable silhouette: a broad radiant CROWN of five upward swept organic spines around the head, incandescent amber-orange tips; several large glowing orange-red sacs exposed high on shoulders/back between armor plates, repeated identically in both views. Crown and sacs are primary focal points. Strong simple volumes, limited small details, not just a resized brute. 
Title "WARLORD", view labels "FRONT", "SIDE", height gauge "5.5 m". Gold 1.8 m soldier silhouette at far right, on SAME baseline and exactly 33% creature height, label "1.8 m". Leave generous margins around spines and feet, no cropping. No franchise characters, no logos, no HUD, no environment.

Use case: stylized-concept. ORIGINAL Earthfall Frontline HIVE organic nest modeling reference sheet, 2048x1152 landscape. Reference image gives STYLE ONLY: chunky faceted low-poly glossy purple swarm with glowing orange/red sacs. Match navy background and thin gold technical rules.
Show TWO views of ONE identical nest: orthographic FRONT left and true SIDE right, same pixel height on same baseline. Nest dimensions 5 m tall by 7 m wide, approximately 5 m deep. Broad grounded nest, not a creature: four large curved purple rib-like spires form a crown around a central cluster of luminous orange-red egg sacs, largest exposed glowing heart visible from front; several smaller sacs between spires. Layered dark plum carapace buttresses at base, thick tapering ROOTS spreading radially flat along ground, readable oval foundation. Few broad simple planes, modelable with cones, tapered curved segments and ovoids. Spires bend inward at top without crossing. No legs, face, mouth or weapons.
Labels "HIVE", "FRONT", "SIDE"; vertical dimension "5 m", front width dimension "7 m". Include a neutral gold soldier silhouette of 1.8 m standing at the right of the side view, SAME scale and SAME baseline; its height should be 36% nest height. Keep roots completely inside sheet and leave clear margins. Original game design, no logo, no HUD, no scenery.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ORIGINAL Earthfall Frontline RED TEAM SOLDIER model turnaround sheet, 2048x1152 landscape. Input image is STYLE AND BODY PROPORTION REFERENCE: match existing teal soldier's chunky low-poly armored human build, armor thickness, scale, limb proportions and clean faceted materials. New Skirmish opponent variant: RUST RED major plates, CHARCOAL under-suit and joints, burnt orange small armor trim, ORANGE-RED illuminated slit and small equipment lights (NO cyan or teal). Clearly DIFFERENT helmet SILHOUETTE: broad flat-topped angular armored brow with two short stepped rectangular side flanges, narrow segmented orange visor, pointed downward chin guard; no round gold ear-disc, no crest or recognizable franchise helmet. Strong readable team identity from front, side and back.
Three equally large full-body orthographic views FRONT, SIDE, BACK in neutral relaxed A stance, arms slightly away from sides, hands EMPTY to expose anatomy, consistent backpack, panels and helmet between views, aligned same height and feet baseline. Compact original charcoal/rust angular radio backpack and hip pouches. Overall 1.8 m tall. Plain dark navy background with restrained gold technical rules. Top title "RED TEAM"; labels "FRONT", "SIDE", "BACK", height gauge "1.8 m". Small three-color swatches along bottom. Keep all feet and helmet fully in frame with generous margins. No logos, emblems, existing characters, weapons, HUD or environment.

Use case: stylized-concept. ORIGINAL Earthfall Frontline STREET PROPS modeling reference sheet. Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: bright Los Angeles art-deco environment, chunky clean low-poly faceted construction, lightly worn broad surfaces, teal/gold human accents. Landscape 2048x1152. Plain dark navy background, thin restrained gold divider rules and labels.
Make a carefully organized 4-column by 2-row grid, EIGHT separate three-quarter view objects, each fully visible with generous space and a readable exact label beneath. No duplicates, no extras. Different grid cells may use different display scale; show shape clearly.
Top row left to right: "WRECKED CAR" = unbranded faded teal compact four-door car, crushed hood, broken windows, flat tires; "WRECKED BUS" = unbranded cream and muted teal city bus, dented body, missing window panes and bent front bumper; "STREET LIGHT" = tall dark charcoal pole with curved arm and one cream lamp, broad base fully visible; "TRAFFIC LIGHT" = upright charcoal pole and horizontal arm carrying standard red amber green signal head, all three lights visible.
Bottom row left to right: "CONCRETE BARRIER" = trapezoid Jersey barrier, worn pale concrete and small gold hazard strips; "DUMPSTER" = teal steel rectangular waste container, two charcoal lid flaps, caster wheels; "PALM PLANTER" = short faceted palm tree with full crown in wide cream concrete square planter, LA feel; "SANDBAG WALL" = waist-high stacked tan fabric sandbags in three staggered rows, short wall with angled end.
Top title "STREET PROPS". Consistent clean studio lighting, sparse damage with broad modelable shapes. Original designs, no manufacturer badges, no vehicle names, no text other than requested labels, no HUD, no scene background.

Use case: stylized-concept. Original Earthfall Frontline KEPLER RIDGE sky texture. Existing image is visual STYLE reference only: chunky clean low-poly/faceted environment painting, saturated open skies, simplified broad geometry. Generate full-bleed 2048x1024 panorama, 2:1 equirectangular 360-degree backdrop, not a concept sheet. VIOLET DUSK sky over distant crystal highlands, low pink sun near horizon toward right of center. Horizon precisely at vertical midpoint y=512, broad open purple sky in upper half, jagged faceted purple crystal mountain ranges forming a thin distant skyline around middle, dark plum rocky highland plain occupying lower half. Airy luminous lilac haze at horizon, magenta sun rim, deep violet overhead, appealing readable low-poly shapes. Both horizontal edges show the SAME quiet hazy sky and low ridge height so LEFT AND RIGHT EDGES JOIN SEAMLESSLY across the 360 seam; no sun, tall peaks, bright clouds or major features near either edge. Top and bottom regions low detail suitable for panorama mapping. Single uninterrupted view, no framing, no text, no borders, no characters, no buildings, no UI, no logos. Original environment design.

Use case: stylized-concept. ORIGINAL Earthfall Frontline CERES STATION sky panorama texture, 2048x1024, 2:1 full-bleed equirectangular 360-degree backdrop. Reference is STYLE ONLY: chunky clean low-poly environmental forms, crisp faceted broad planes.
Black airless SPACE fills upper half, hard small white stars sparsely scattered, one LARGE original RINGED PLANET at upper right of center, muted pale gold-grey bands and oblique thin rings, fully visible away from borders. Use case: stylized-concept. Create ORIGINAL Earthfall Frontline KEPLER RIDGE ground albedo texture, exactly 1024x1024 square, full bleed. Original texture, no text, logo or UI.

Use case: stylized-concept. Original Earthfall Frontline STATION WALL albedo texture, 1024x1024 square full bleed. Input image is palette and chunky low-poly material reference only. A flat front-on orthographic METAL SPACE STATION WALL, broad charcoal and blue-grey steel panels, subtle muted teal structural ribs, small gold safety blocks, two rows of SMALL inset lit rectangular windows with restrained warm white/cyan light. Use case: stylized-concept. ORIGINAL Earthfall Frontline title-screen background illustration, EXACT final aspect 16:9, 1920x1080. Reference image is style and original faction reference: chunky clean low-poly faceted soldiers in teal armor with gold plates and cyan lights, glossy purple swarm with orange/red sacs, bright saturated open Los Angeles sky, cream art-deco city and palms. Do not reproduce its panel layout. One full-bleed cinematic scene, no borders or text.
Composition is critical: LEFT THIRD (x=0..640 of 1920) is CALM LOW-CONTRAST DARK NAVY/TEAL NEGATIVE SPACE for future menu, formed naturally by shaded unobtrusive ridge slope and smooth blue sky/haze; no soldiers, weapons, palm trunks, strong sun highlights, swarm, beam, buildings or busy silhouettes in that left third. Keep transition gradual, not an obvious panel.
On RIGHT TWO THIRDS, a squad of four original teal/gold armored soldiers holds a defensive line on a ridge at the edge of Los Angeles, seen mostly from back and three-quarter rear, aiming original compact angular rifles toward distant hills. Heroic grounded posture, readable separate silhouettes. Purple organic swarm pours over distant hills on far right, orange weak-point glows. Beyond squad: cream downtown art-deco towers and neighborhoods with palm trees, bright open afternoon sky and soft white clouds. A thin brilliant gold-cyan ORBITAL STRIKE BEAM descends from upper sky onto distant right-side hill with small glowing impact, no gore, no overwhelming explosion. Palm crowns and trees confined to right two-thirds. Clear depth and strong focal hierarchy. Faceted stylized 3D illustration, clean game key art, optimistic heroic daylight with shaded foreground. No text, lettering, logos, watermarks, UI, title treatment or copied franchise armor/weapons.
